instruction: Candid medium shot of a bright indoor living room. On a dark couch, the woman in the blue t-shirt and beige pants (R2) sits on the left, facing right and gesturing with her hands held close together. Opposite her, the woman in the white dress with black sleeves (R1) sits on the right, facing left and gesturing with raised hands. They are actively conversing. The background has large windows and potted plants. Bright natural light fills the room, highlighting the neutral color palette.
